_doc.purpose: Ties each template in the email-template Google Doc to the copy shipped in extensions/adminbot/src/workflows/onboarding/emails.ts.
_doc.why: The doc is where the templates are written and reviewed; emails.ts is what gets sent. Keeping them in step was a manual transcription every time somebody edited a paragraph. scripts/adminbot-email-templates-sync.ts reads this map and reports the differences; nothing writes emails.ts automatically, because the doc is a working document and an unattended writer would ship its half-finished edits.
_doc.identity: A section is keyed by its slug line when it has one -- three do, e.g. 'top1-30min-zhijing' -- and otherwise by its nearest heading. Slugs are better: a heading rename shows up as an unmapped section, which is noise the person renaming has to clear. Worth asking for a slug line on every template.
_doc.unmapped: Anything on neither list is reported as drift. docOnly and codeOnly are the deliberate exceptions, each with the reason it is one.

docOnly.G. Acquaintance: The doc's own note says acquaintances need no email, and emails.ts says the same: the access-level algorithm grants the subgroup's items and that is the whole onboarding.
docOnly.Interview moderate result [Needs work]: Marked [Needs work] in the doc and has no subject line yet. Nothing to ship until it is finished.
docOnly.1. Pre-submission heads-up + sign-off re: PaperFlow co-author mail. Sent by the main lead from the paper's own thread, not by the onboarding sender.
docOnly.6. Social media draft sign-off request (: Social-draft consent flow, which composes from the draft record rather than a stored template.
docOnly.12. City-based dinner / team-building in: Not implemented. The city-channel sweep adds people to a channel; the dinner invitation is still written by hand.
docOnly.Variant A: accept: Recommendation-letter handling is case-by-case by design; only the disappearing-coauthor decline is automated.

codeOnly.interviewee: Subgroup follow-up after a conversation. Written in code before the doc existed; no section covers it yet.
codeOnly.slightly_better_than_emails: Subgroup onboarding for the lightest collaboration tier. No doc section yet.
codeOnly.member: Full-member onboarding. The doc covers the external tiers; the internal welcome has never been in it.
codeOnly.member_rejection: Application outcome for a full-member applicant. No doc section yet.
codeOnly.member_what_to_expect: The supplement appended to the member welcome. Its prose lives in the doc's second tab (What to Expect), which this checker does not read -- the tab is written as guidance for people, not as a mail body.
